text: PART III - LANDS FINAL ORDERS LAND SETTLEMENT ORDINANCE Settlement Orders No. 1907 (Kurunegala) (Amendment) Correction THE name of the claimants of Sub-land lot Nos. 145,310,458 and 785 in the Land Settlement Final Order which was published in the part III of Gazette Extraordinary No. 2335/20 of 08/06/2023 of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka ,according to the Settlement Notice No. 5534 (Kurunegala) Published for the Village named Kirimetiyawa(B.S.V.P No.3683 (North West ) Situated in Kirimetiyawa Grama Niladhari Division in Mahawa Divisional Secretary’s Division of Pahala Visideka Koralaya in Kurunegala District of North Western Province are amended as per below Schedule : SUVINDA S. SINGAPPULI, Assistant Settlement officer/ Commissioner of Land Title Settlement (Land) Land Title Settlement Department, Battaramulla, 14th May, 2024.
